name: Preference-Based Teaching Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: Use preference order $000\succ011\succ101$. The empty sample teaches the most preferred target; $(x_1,1)$ teaches $011$, and $(x_2,1)$ teaches $101$. Thus the value is at most one, and zero is impossible for a non-singleton class. Hence $\mathrm{PBTD}=1$.
references: Direct calculation from the class definition; compare \cite{gao2017preference}.
